items.source: Default implementation of the PersistenceUnitManager interface.

items.source: Uses of PersistenceUnitManager in org.springframework.orm.jpa.persistenceunit
items.translation: `PersistenceUnitManager` 接口在 `org.springframework.orm.jpa.persistenceunit` 包中的使用：

items.source: Package providing integration of JPA (Java Persistence API) with Spring concepts.
items.translation: 提供将 JPA（Java 持久化 API）与 Spring 概念集成的包。

items.source: Internal support for managing JPA persistence units.
items.translation: 用于管理 JPA 持久化单元的内部支持。

items.source:
Determine the PersistenceUnitInfo to use for the EntityManagerFactory
created by this bean.
items.translation: 确定此 Bean 创建的 EntityManagerFactory 要使用的 PersistenceUnitInfo。

items.source:
Set the PersistenceUnitManager to use for obtaining the JPA persistence unit
that this FactoryBean is supposed to build an EntityManagerFactory for.
items.translation: 设置用于获取此 FactoryBean 打算为其构建 EntityManagerFactory 的 JPA 持久化单元的 PersistenceUnitManager。
